releaseNotes: Library now has Saved, Inbox and WhatsApp tabs. WhatsApp downloaded files are separated from normal shared Inbox items. Inbox adds an on-demand Analyze action for English images/screenshots and PDFs using the existing local OCR bridge only when requested. Analyze looks for subscription, expiry, renewal, warranty, contract, due-date and end-date wording, confirms a detected date, and can schedule a local Android reminder 1, 7 or 30 days before the date.
